job.job_description:
We are looking for Gen AI engineers for HCL Tech




Key skill: Python, Fast API, Gen AI

Experience: 7+ Years

Notice Period: Immediate joiner

Location: Chennai, Hyderabad, Bangalore, Noida, Pune





Detailed Responsibilities

Design, implement, and maintain backend APIs and services using Python 3.12+ and FastAPI.
Develop, optimize, and operate multi-agent GenAI workflows using Google ADK 2.0 as the primary orchestration and structured-output toolkit.
Integrate, tune, and manage LLM providers and GenAI toolkits (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google) to deliver safe and effective conversational AI solutions.
Support and extend workflows using other orchestration frameworks (LangGraph, LangChain, PydanticAI) to ensure seamless interoperability.
Implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), prompt engineering, structured output validation, and AI guardrails for secure and reliable model behavior.
Build and integrate domain-specific task handlers for healthcare workflows, including care tasks, medication management, and scheduling, with clinical systems as required.
Leverage Azure services (Cosmos DB, App Configuration, Key Vault, Event Hubs, Application Insights) for robust data management, configuration, secrets, and telemetry.
Ensure API security and PHI (Protected Health Information) protection using JWT/OAuth and industry best practices.
Author and maintain automated tests (pytest) and support CI/CD pipelines and containerized deployments for continuous integration and delivery.
Monitor and analyze ML system performance using Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, and Fluentd, ensuring system reliability and rapid issue resolution.
Automate infrastructure provisioning and deployment using DevOps tools such as Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, and Ansible.
Participate in code reviews, architecture design, production support, incident response, and process compliance.
Collaborate with internal stakeholders, prepare and present project status reports, and support feasibility studies to evaluate technical alternatives and risks.



Skill Requirements

Minimum 7 years of professional software development experience, with a strong background in Python and asynchronous frameworks (FastAPI preferred).
Advanced proficiency in MLOps tools including MLflow, Kubeflow Pipelines, TFX, and Metaflow.
Hands-on experience with Google ADK 2.0 for multi-agent orchestration and structured LLM outputs.
Familiarity with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangGraph, LangChain, PydanticAI) and ability to work across toolchains.
Demonstrated expertise in GenAI, including prompt engineering, RAG, structured output validation, and AI safety/guardrail implementation.
Experience integrating OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and Google ADK 2.0.
Practical knowledge of Azure services (Cosmos DB, Key Vault, App Configuration) and containerized production deployments (Docker, GitHub Actions).
Advanced skills in DevOps tools: Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, Ansible, Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, CircleCI, GitHub Actions.
Strong familiarity with monitoring and logging tools: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, Fluentd.
Proficient in version control systems: Git, GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket.
Solid understanding of cloud infrastructure, deployment strategies, event-driven architectures, and workflow engines.
Strong understanding of API security best practices, JWT/OAuth, and PHI protection.
Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
Proven ability to operate with high ownership in a small, fast-paced, and collaborative team environment.
